Delete a document

Source: R/delete_document.R
delete_document.Rd

Deletes a document or folder.

Usage

delete_document(api, document_id)

Arguments

api

Your Sportity API key. Avoid writing it in scripts; store it in the SPORTITY_API environment variable and use Sys.getenv("SPORTITY_API").

document_id

Id of the document, as returned by list_documents().

Value

No return value, called for side effects. Prints a confirmation message.

See also

Other document functions: create_folder(), create_image(), create_link(), create_pdf(), create_text(), list_documents(), reorder_document()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
delete_document(
  api = Sys.getenv("SPORTITY_API"),
  document_id = "my_document_id"
)
} # }
